paper_title: The Safety Reminder A Soft Prompt to Reactivate Delayed Safety   Awareness in Vision-Language Models
caption: The proportion of harmful responses in which the model showed a rejection tendency.

annotations.annotation: The plot illustrates the "Harmful with Refusal Ratio" across different sample sizes for two models on two benchmarks. The x-axis is labeled with sample sizes, presented on a linear scale with tick marks at values 128, 256, 512, and 1024. The y-axis represents the "Harmful with Refusal Ratio," also on a linear scale, with values ranging from 0.0 to 0.5 in increments of 0.1. The blue line, with circular dot style representing "LlaVA-1.5-7B on FigStep", starts at approximately 0.2 at 128, increases to about 0.34 at 512, and remains steady through 1024. The orange line with squared dot, "Qwen2-VL-7B on FigStep", begins at around 0.15, rises to approximately 0.42 at 512, and maintains that level at 1024. The green line, "LlaVA-1.5-7B on MMSafetyBench", starts at approximately 0.08 and rises to nearly 0.37 by 512, remaining constant thereafter. The red line with diamond dots, "Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench," begins at 0.25, reaches at approximately 0.42 at 512, and slightly increases to 0.52 at 1024. There is a legend available at the bottom right of the plot to map different line styles to their labels.
